BSB reads “Amon” with the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Amos” (Ἀμώς). The repeated “begot” is expressed through fatherhood.
“Publicly” makes the exposure explicit; “divorce” interprets sending away.
“Are to give” expresses the future naming as an instruction.
“Embraced Mary as his wife” interprets receiving his wife; Mary’s name is supplied.
